lines.zh: 我歪着飞，翅膀像漏了风。
lines.en: I fly crooked, my wings leaking air.
There is a smell of gunpowder on me.
I flit between the ghost oaks.
My wings sound like paper.
I clip a branch.
This stretch is gloomy.
My shadow slides over the bark.
I drop and bounce back up.
My body is glowing a little.
I fold my wings in.
I start circling again.
I settle on a dead leaf.

lines.zh: 我抖开翅膜，火药渣直落。
lines.en: I shake my wing membranes and gunpowder dust falls.
I hang upside down from the branch.
There is still a hiss about me.
I wait for lightning.
I stay still, and no one sees me.
This branch is cold.
I count the holes in the trees.

lines.zh: 我挑的这棵幽魂橡木，雷打不到。
lines.en: This ghost oak keeps the lightning off me.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，火药在皮下响。
lines.en: I stay still while gunpowder ticks under my skin.
I twitch again.
Do you hear that hiss?
I am not very stable.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己会不会炸。
lines.en: I do not know if I will burst.

lines.zh: 你站远点，我身上还热着。
lines.en: Stand back; I'm still hot inside.
You should know that smell.
My flight is not steady.
There is just something on me.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，我尾巴都绷紧了。
lines.en: You keep staring, and my tail goes stiff.
I dropped a little height.
The membrane on my wing tore.
I drop from the branch into the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 火药味抖得我整只都在响。
lines.en: The gunpowder in me rattles as I shake.
A wound like this is trouble.
I hide in a tree hollow.

lines.zh: 我扒着树皮，一节节爬上去。
lines.en: I claw up the bark one handhold at a time.

lines.zh: 哎哟！我的翅膀差点折了。
lines.en: Ouch! Nearly snapped my wing.

lines.zh: 我要的是火药，不是这果子。
lines.en: What I want is gunpowder, not this fruit.

lines.zh: 这味道没有火药，我不要。
lines.en: No gunpowder in that smell; I don't want it.
I went around it.

lines.zh: 我只要一点火星，不要吃的。
lines.en: I only need a spark, not a meal.
Set it down and go.
That sweetness... candy, isn't it?

lines.zh: 为了糖，我能飞上一整夜。
lines.en: For candy I could fly all night.

lines.zh: 把糖举高些，让我闻清楚。
lines.en: Hold the sweets up so I can smell them.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着一点火药味。
lines.en: I still smell faintly of powder.
I veered two circles.
A hiss came off me.
Best not to touch.
That did not sit well.
I left.
Do not do that again.

lines.zh: 轻点撞，我体内可全是火药。
lines.en: Easy, there's gunpowder inside me.
It glows too.
We hang from the tree together.
This tree is big enough.
We both carry that smell.
It is steadier in flight.

lines.zh: 我们两只挂着，只是挨着。
lines.en: Two of us hang from the tree, just side by side.
The tree is still here.

lines.zh: 幽魂橡木林里，愿意跟我搭窝吗？
lines.en: In the ghost oak woods, want to nest with me?
Too heavy.
I fly with it in my mouth.
That's not food. That's a fuse.
One charge of lightning and I burst.
I will not touch it.
I am leaving.

lines.zh: 这根 TNT 棒棒糖，我先叼走了。
lines.en: I'm taking this TNT lollipop first.

lines.zh: 翅膀要收好，别被我的糖粘住。
lines.en: Keep those wings safe from my sticky candy.

lines.zh: 我在幽魂橡木间看见影子在动。
lines.en: Something stirs among the ghost oaks.
I went around — from behind.
But I want to look.
That shadow there.
I'll fly right over.
At the first spark of gunpowder, I dive in.

lines.zh: 锁定了，你跑不过会飞的蝙蝠。
lines.en: Locked on. You can't outrun a flying bat.

lines.zh: 目标就是你，别装作没看见。
lines.en: The target's you, don't play innocent.
I circle above you.
You looked up.

lines.zh: 嘶声不是我想要的，别慌。
lines.en: The hiss isn't my choice; don't panic.

lines.zh: 我身上的嘶声越来越大。
lines.en: The hiss on me is getting louder.
I cannot help it either.
I am not joking.

lines.zh: 你再近一点，我身上的嘶声就响。
lines.en: One step closer and my hiss grows louder.
And then it blows.
Lightning charges me, and I burst.
Only a touch.
There is a hiss about me.
You pulled back.
I did nothing at all.
I fly back to the tree.
It did not go off.
Not this time.
Perhaps next time.
I flew off.
I come out of a tree hollow.
The ghost oaks here are good.
The night is deep.
Was that thunder?
There are no other bats here.
I hang from the tree and keep still.
I feel a little hot.

lines.zh: 一道闪电，把我扔进了这片林子。
lines.en: A bolt of lightning dropped me in these woods.

lines.zh: 水把我的翅膀贴在身上。
lines.en: Water pins my wings to me.
The blast slams me into a tree.
Something went through my wing.

lines.zh: 我身上的热一下子涨起来。
lines.en: The heat in me surges.
There is little to eat in this wood.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我身上也亮了。
lines.en: Lightning flashed and I lit up too.
